description: Source code for the ApplicationEditor class in a GUI application, part of MenuLibre, an advanced menu editor. Defines a GTK-based widget with various UI components for editing application menu entries.

classes.name: ApplicationEditor
classes.description: A GTK widget class for editing application menu entries, including icon, name, comment, command, working directory, options, categories, actions, and advanced settings.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets a specific key-value pair in the editor, updating the corresponding UI component.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current value for a specific key from the editor.

methods.name: remove_incomplete_actions
methods.description: Removes incomplete actions from the action editor.

methods.name: get_actions
methods.description: Returns the list of actions from the action editor.

methods.name: clear_categories
methods.description: Clears all categories in the category editor.

methods.name: insert_required_categories
methods.description: Inserts required categories based on the parent directory.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels editing of name and comment fields.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits changes to name and comment fields.

methods.name: take_focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the icon entry widget.

methods.name: _on_changed
methods.description: Internal callback triggered when a property value changes, emitting 'value-changed' signal.
